verified_features.evidence: Fresh scheduled appointment for patient ACS-2026-254ED907 (TESTC WAIT ZM7L) rendered on Waiting column with [data-testid=dq-next-stage-ACS-2026-254ED907] label '→ Check-in'. Click flipped counts waiting 1→0, checked_in 0→1 without page navigation (URL stayed /test). Card outer default-handler did NOT navigate (stopPropagation guard works).

After first click, same patient re-appeared in dq-col-checked_in with chip label '→ Start test'. Clicking it opened the /test procedures view (Pure Tone/Impedance/Speech tabs) with 'Active test: TESTC WAIT ZM7L' banner — matches spec (start_and_navigate).
Existing in_progress card 'TEST UI B 787' rendered chip '→ COMPLETE'. Clicking flipped in_progress 2→1 and completed 0→1; URL unchanged.
dq-col-completed contained 1 card ('TEST UI B 787') with a 'View report' CTA and ZERO [data-testid^=dq-next-stage-] elements (verified via document.querySelectorAll count = 0).

pytest test_diagnostics_queue_checkin.py — 4/4 PASS: promote scheduled→checked_in, idempotent second call returns already_checked_in=true, refuses to demote in_progress, no-match returns ok=true. Fixed pre-existing slot-collision bug in helper (see updated_files).

In Reports tab of active session, sidebar shows Print size block containing [data-testid=report-compact-toggle] checkbox with label 'Fit to 1 A4 page' + helper 'Compact mode — tighter spacing, small audiogram, Tymp inline. Saves a sheet of paper per print.'

verified_features.item: Phase D — class + testid toggle on #report-preview
verified_features.evidence: OFF: class='mx-auto bg-white shadow-lg report-page ' testid=report-compact-off. ON: class='...report-page report-compact' testid=report-compact-on. Un-tick removes report-compact and restores testid to report-compact-off.

verified_features.item: Phase D — Audiogram size picker forced-disabled by compact
verified_features.evidence: With Tymp placement='New page' (useSeparatePage=true), Standard/Large/Extra Large buttons are enabled (opacity 1, disabled=false). Ticking compact toggle → all 3 become disabled (opacity 0.4, cursor not-allowed) since compactLayout forces useSeparatePage=false in ReportsPanel.js:157-159.

verified_features.item: Phase D — Tymp placement override + page-break suppression
verified_features.evidence: With Tymp 'New page', #report-preview .report-page-break exists (true). After compact ON, that element is REMOVED (query returns null) → Tymp is forced inline as the effectiveTympPlacement collapses to inline. Preview screenshot confirms PTA + Tymp on one A4 sheet.

critical_code_review_comments: DiagnosticsQueueBoard.js:580-593 — chip button correctly calls e.stopPropagation() before invoking nextStage.handler(), and honours isBusy via disabled attribute. Good.

ReportsPanel.js:157-160 — compactLayout override logic is clean and one-liner; effectiveAudiogramSize + useSeparatePage both derived from single source of truth (compactLayout). No divergent code paths.

BuilderSidebar.js:530-550 — Print size block uses a nested <input> inside <label> with visual styling swap (bg-emerald-50 vs bg-white). Consistent with the rest of the sidebar's design language. data-testid on the input, not the label — the Playwright test still worked but if you want to click on the label region for a11y, the testid would need to move.

backend/routers/diagnostics_queue.py — new /queue/checkin endpoint promote-only guard prevents demotion; test_checkin_refuses_to_demote_in_progress locks that in. Idempotent contract is honored (already_checked_in flag).
